learning_outcomes.text: Analyzes time-varying electromagnetic fields using Maxwell's equations and Faraday's law.
Explains the propagation, polarization, and behavior of plane electromagnetic waves under boundary conditions.
Calculates the power transmission mechanism of electromagnetic waves using the Poynting vector.
Evaluates the transmission of electromagnetic waves and their characteristic parameters in transmission lines and waveguides.
Performs high-frequency circuit analyses using applications such as impedance matching, Smith chart, and resonators.

syllabus_topics: Maxwell's Equations and potential functions, Electromagnetic Boundary Conditions
Harmonic Fields in Time, Phasor Representations, Electromagnetic Spectrum
Plane Electromagnetic Waves, TEM waves and polarization
TEM waves in low and highly lossy media, Group Velocity
Electromagnetic power flow and Poynting vector, Plane Wave Medium Change
Oblique incidence of plane waves on boundaries, total reflection, perpendicular and parallel polarization, Brewster's angle
Propagation of Transverse Electromagnetic waves in waveguides and general transmission line equations and parameters
Wave properties in finite and infinite transmission lines, Characteristic impedance, Standing wave ratio
Smith Chart, impedance matching in transmission lines
Waveguides and behavior of TEM, TM, TE wave types along the waveguide
bibliography: David K. Cheng; Fundamentals of Engineering Electromagnetics
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
